Register isolated ARGENTUM C4 manual compile-only preflight [skip ci]

Exactly one dispatch-only workflow addition. Implementation pinned to 33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6. Main is unprotected with no required checks or rulesets at verified readback; skip marker prevents unrelated main push CI. No production or existing workflow changes.

+name: ARGENTUM C4 cold compile only 20261015
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      approval:
+        description: Exact source-bound C4 compile-only acknowledgement
+        required: true
+        type: string
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: argentum-c4-cold-compile-only-20261015
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  cold-compile:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      max-parallel: 2
+      matrix:
+        revision: [R5, R6]
+    steps:
+      - name: Fail-closed original and approval gate before downloads
+        env:
+          APPROVAL: ${{ inputs.approval }}
+          WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = GodaPupa/argentum-batshit-test
+          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch
+          test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/infra/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015
+          test "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1/1
+          test "$WORKFLOW_REF" = GodaPupa/argentum-batshit-test/.github/workflows/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015.yml@refs/heads/infra/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015
+          test "$APPROVAL" = C4_COMPILE_ONLY_ONCE_33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/dispatch-commit.txt"
+          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/run-identity.txt"
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
+        with:
+          ref: '33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6'
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Verify pinned implementation before toolchains
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6
+          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = ed87a9c5ea6a60d968ee0856095b593a614f3816
+          cd qualification/c4-preflight
+          sha256sum -c SOURCE_SHA256SUMS
+          cp SOURCE_SHA256SUMS "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/implementation-SHA256SUMS"
+          cp "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/dispatch-event.json"
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@cf277c60eb25467037889841efdb72551f06f6c3
+        with:
+          distribution: microsoft
+          java-version: '21'
+      - name: Install exact official Just
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" https://github.com/casey/just/releases/download/1.59.0/just-1.59.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
+          echo "409044617b6f06517c1035e55ca38c8c856ff8b650e41bc2aa1ef82d5903a23e  $RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin"
+          tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin" just
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Compile frozen variant only
+        env:
+          C4_REVISION: ${{ matrix.revision }}
+        run: python3 qualification/c4-preflight/preflight.py
+      - name: Seal complete or partial evidence
+        if: ${{ always() }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          if ! test -f result.json; then printf '%s\n' '{"status":"INCOMPLETE","reason":"preflight did not finish"}' > result.json; fi
+          find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        if: ${{ always() }}
+        with:
+          name: argentum-c4-${{ matrix.revision }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c4-evidence
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+"""Receive original payment diagnostic; never infer correctness from green CI."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json,zipfile,tempfile,hashlib,subprocess,os,sys
+H=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;P=json.loads((H/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+blob=lambda b:hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
+def receive():
+    pins=json.loads((H/'PINS.json').read_text());m=json.loads((H/'metadata.json').read_text());run=m['run'];jobs=m['jobs']['jobs'];a=m['artifact']
+    assert run['id']==pins['run'] and run['head_sha']==pins['validation'] and run['workflow_id']==pins['workflow_id'] and run['path']==pins['workflow']
+    assert run['head_branch']==pins['branch'] and run['run_attempt']==run['run_number']==1 and run['event']=='push' and run['status']=='completed'
+    assert len(jobs)==1;job=jobs[0]
+    assert job['id']==pins['job'] and job['run_id']==pins['run'] and job['run_attempt']==1 and job['status']=='completed'
+    assert a['name']==pins['artifact_name'] and not a['expired'] and a['workflow_run']['id']==pins['run'] and a['workflow_run']['head_sha']==pins['validation']
+    for key,parent in [('source',P['base']),('validation',pins['source'])]:
+        assert m[key]['sha']==pins[key] and m[key]['tree']['sha']==pins['tree' if key=='source' else 'validation_tree']
+        assert [p['sha'] for p in m[key]['parents']]==[parent]
+    assert m['main']['sha']==P['main']
+    assert sorted(f['filename'] for f in m['source_delta']['files'])==sorted(P['source_delta'])
+    assert [f['filename'] for f in m['validation_delta']['files']]==[pins['workflow']]
+    data=(H/'original.zip').read_bytes()
+    assert len(data)==a['size_in_bytes'] and 'sha256:'+sha(data)==a['digest']
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(H/'original.zip') as z:
+        assert z.testzip() is None;names=[n for n in z.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')]
+        assert len(names)==len(set(names)) and all(not n.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(n).parts for n in names)
+        raw={n:z.read(n) for n in names}
+    manifest=json.loads(raw['MANIFEST.json'])
+    assert set(manifest)==set(raw)-{'MANIFEST.json'} and all(sha(raw[k])==v for k,v in manifest.items())
+    b=json.loads(raw['BINDING.json'])
+    for k in ['source','tree','validation','validation_tree','workflow','workflow_blob']:assert b[k]==pins[k]
+    assert b['run']==str(pins['run']) and b['attempt']==b['run_number']==1
+    assert blob(raw['WORKFLOW.yml'])==pins['workflow_blob']
+    for n,h in pins['protocol_files'].items():assert sha(raw['protocol/'+n])==h
+    assert json.loads(raw['protocol/PROTOCOL.json'])==P
+    for label in ['initial','pre-behavior','final']:
+        assert raw[label+'/TRACKED.diff']==b''
+        for path,h in {**P['bindings'],**P['protected']}.items():assert sha(raw[label+'/source/'+path])==h,(label,path)
+        for path,h in P['blob_bindings'].items():assert blob(raw[label+'/source/'+path])==h,(label,path)
+    normal=raw['initial/source/'+P['test_path']]
+    assert normal.count(P['mutation']['from'].encode())==1
+    mutant=normal.replace(P['mutation']['from'].encode(),P['mutation']['to'].encode())
+    assert sha(mutant)==P['mutation']['sha256']
+    errors=[];gates={}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+        root=Path(td)
+        for n,body in raw.items():p=root/n;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(body)
+        sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'protocol'))
+        from reports import stage
+        for name in P['stages']:
+            try:
+                assert raw[name+'/FORM.kt']==(mutant if name in ['compile-mutant','mutant'] else normal)
+                gates[name]=stage(root/name)
+            except Exception as e:errors.append(dict(stage=name,error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)))
+    if 'FAILURE.txt' in raw:errors.append(dict(stage='collector',error=raw['FAILURE.txt'].decode()))
+    state='RECEIVED_DIAGNOSTIC_GAP_REPRODUCED_NOT_REPAIRED' if not errors and run['conclusion']==job['conclusion']=='success' else 'ORIGINAL_FAILURE_RECEIVED_NOT_ACCEPTED'
+    receipt=dict(pins,state=state,artifact=a['id'],artifact_bytes=len(data),artifact_sha256=sha(data),manifest_entries=len(manifest),gates=gates,gate_errors=errors,feature_acceptance=False,card_registration=False,official_games=0,official_seeds=0,precision_reserved=2)
+    (H/'VERIFIED_RECEIPT.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(state=state,errors=errors)))
+if __name__=='__main__':receive()

+"""Synthetic auditor checks, never substituted for executable engine evidence."""
+from reports import reports,P
+from copy import deepcopy
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+def fixture(variant):
+    expected=P['witnesses'][variant]
+    root=ET.Element('testsuite',tests='4',errors='0',skipped='0',failures=str(len(expected)))
+    for name in P['cases']:
+        row=ET.SubElement(root,'testcase',name=name,classname=P['class'])
+        if name in expected:
+            w=expected[name];f=ET.SubElement(row,'failure',type='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError',message=' '.join(w['contains']))
+            f.text='ActivatedPhyrexianPaymentDiagnosticTest.kt:'+str(w['line'])
+    return root
+def check(root,variant='baseline'):
+    return reports({'TEST-diagnostic.xml':ET.tostring(root)},variant)
+for variant in ['baseline','mutant']:check(fixture(variant),variant)
+checks=[]
+def reject(name,edit):
+    root=fixture('baseline');edit(root)
+    try:check(root)
+    except (AssertionError,ValueError):checks.append(name)
+    else:raise AssertionError('accepted invalid '+name)
+reject('missing case',lambda r:r.remove(r.findall('testcase')[0]))
+reject('duplicate identity',lambda r:r.findall('testcase')[0].set('name',r.findall('testcase')[1].get('name')))
+reject('wrong class',lambda r:r.findall('testcase')[0].set('classname','other.Class'))
+reject('unexpected skip',lambda r:ET.SubElement(r.findall('testcase')[0],'skipped'))
+reject('error not assertion',lambda r:ET.SubElement(r.findall('testcase')[0],'error'))
+reject('wrong assertion type',lambda r:r.find('.//failure').set('type','java.lang.IllegalStateException'))
+reject('wrong frame',lambda r:setattr(r.find('.//failure'),'text','ActivatedPhyrexianPaymentDiagnosticTest.kt:1'))
+reject('missing expected failure',lambda r:r.findall('testcase')[1].remove(r.find('.//failure')))
+reject('unrelated assertion',lambda r:r.find('.//failure').set('message','unrelated assertion'))
+reject('wrong summary',lambda r:r.set('failures','0'))
+try:reports({},'baseline')
+except AssertionError:checks.append('missing report')
+else:raise AssertionError('empty reports accepted')
+print('Synthetic receiver rejections: '+str(len(checks)))

+"""Strict diagnostic receiving. Expected baseline failures are not feature acceptance."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json,re,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+P=json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name('PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+
+def reports(raw, variant):
+    assert len(raw)==1
+    root=ET.fromstring(next(iter(raw.values())))
+    rows=root.findall('testcase')
+    assert len(rows)==4 and root.get('tests')=='4'
+    assert root.get('errors')=='0' and root.get('skipped')=='0'
+    assert sorted(r.get('name') for r in rows)==sorted(P['cases'])
+    assert all(r.get('classname')==P['class'] for r in rows)
+    expected=P['witnesses'][variant]
+    failed={r.get('name'):r.find('failure') for r in rows if r.find('failure') is not None}
+    assert set(failed)==set(expected) and int(root.get('failures'))==len(expected)
+    assert not any(r.find('error') is not None or r.find('skipped') is not None for r in rows)
+    for name,f in failed.items():
+        assert f.get('type')=='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError'
+        frame=re.search(r'ActivatedPhyrexianPaymentDiagnosticTest\.kt:(\d+)',f.text or '')
+        assert frame and int(frame.group(1))==expected[name]['line'],name
+        for token in expected[name]['contains']:
+            assert token in (f.get('message','')+'\n'+(f.text or '')),(name,token)
+    return dict(cases=[r.get('name') for r in rows],passed=4-len(failed),failures=len(failed),errors=0,skips=0,witnesses=expected)
+
+def stage(folder):
+    folder=Path(folder);name=folder.name
+    rc=int((folder/'exit.txt').read_text());log=(folder/'output.log').read_text()
+    assert not re.search(r'^e: |Compilation error|Unresolved reference',log,re.M)
+    if name.startswith('compile-'):
+        assert rc==0 and 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in log
+        assert re.search(r'^> Task :rules-engine:compileTestKotlin(?: UP-TO-DATE)?$',log,re.M)
+        assert not re.search(r'^> Task :rules-engine:test(?: |$)',log,re.M)
+        assert not list(folder.rglob('TEST-*.xml'))
+        return dict(compiled=True,behavioral_tests=0)
+    assert rc!=0
+    assert re.findall(r'^> Task (\S+) FAILED$',log,re.M)==[':rules-engine:test']
+    return reports({p.name:p.read_bytes() for p in folder.glob('junit/TEST-*.xml')},'mutant' if name=='mutant' else 'baseline')

+"""One unregistered fixture diagnostic; no runtime repair or card admission."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json,os,subprocess,hashlib,shutil
+from reports import stage
+ROOT=Path.cwd();HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'manual-activation-payment-diagnostic-r1-evidence'
+P=json.loads((HERE/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text());sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
+TARGET=ROOT/P['test_path'];NORMAL=TARGET.read_bytes();MUTANT=NORMAL.replace(P['mutation']['from'].encode(),P['mutation']['to'].encode())
+def save(p,b):p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
+def bind(label):
+    source=os.environ['SOURCE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',source+'^{tree}')==os.environ['SOURCE_TREE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',source+'^')==P['base'] and git('rev-parse','HEAD^')==source
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',source,'HEAD')==os.environ['WORKFLOW']
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',P['base'],source).splitlines()==sorted(P['source_delta'])
+    assert git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')==P['main']
+    assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')
+    for p,h in {**P['bindings'],**P['protected']}.items():
+        b=(ROOT/p).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==h,p;save(OUT/label/'source'/p,b)
+    for p,h in P['blob_bindings'].items():
+        assert git('hash-object',p)==h;save(OUT/label/'source'/p,(ROOT/p).read_bytes())
+    save(OUT/label/'TRACKED.diff',subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--']))
+def run(name,recipe):
+    folder=OUT/name;folder.mkdir()
+    results=ROOT/'rules-engine/build/test-results/test'
+    if results.exists():shutil.rmtree(results)
+    with (folder/'output.log').open('wb') as f:
+        rc=subprocess.run(['just','--working-directory',str(ROOT),'--justfile',str(HERE/'validation.just'),recipe],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
+    (folder/'exit.txt').write_text(str(rc))
+    if results.exists():shutil.copytree(results,folder/'junit')
+    save(folder/'FORM.kt',TARGET.read_bytes())
+    if name.startswith('compile-'):stage(folder)
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);bind('initial')
+    assert NORMAL.count(P['mutation']['from'].encode())==1
+    assert sha(NORMAL)==P['bindings'][P['test_path']] and sha(MUTANT)==P['mutation']['sha256']
+    for f in HERE.iterdir():
+        if f.is_file():save(OUT/'protocol'/f.name,f.read_bytes())
+    save(OUT/'WORKFLOW.yml',(ROOT/os.environ['WORKFLOW']).read_bytes())
+    b=dict(source=os.environ['SOURCE'],tree=os.environ['SOURCE_TREE'],validation=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),validation_tree=git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),workflow=os.environ['WORKFLOW'],workflow_blob=git('hash-object',os.environ['WORKFLOW']),run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],attempt=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']),run_number=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER']))
+    assert b['attempt']==b['run_number']==1;save(OUT/'BINDING.json',(json.dumps(b,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
+    subprocess.run(['python3',str(HERE/'check_controls.py')],check=True)
+    run('compile-normal','compile')
+    TARGET.write_bytes(MUTANT);run('compile-mutant','compile')
+    TARGET.write_bytes(NORMAL);bind('pre-behavior')
+    run('baseline','diagnose')
+    TARGET.write_bytes(MUTANT);run('mutant','diagnose')
+    TARGET.write_bytes(NORMAL);run('restored','diagnose')
+    # Preserve all original reports before judging the diagnostic hypothesis.
+    gates={name:stage(OUT/name) for name in P['stages']}
+    (OUT/'DIAGNOSTIC.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='DIAGNOSTIC_GAP_REPRODUCED_NOT_REPAIRED',gates=gates),indent=2)+'\n')
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    try:main()
+    except Exception as e:
+        OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(OUT/'FAILURE.txt').write_text(type(e).__name__+': '+str(e));raise
+    finally:
+        TARGET.write_bytes(NORMAL)
+        try:bind('final')
+        finally:
+            manifest={str(f.relative_to(OUT)):sha(f.read_bytes()) for f in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f.name!='MANIFEST.json'}
+            (OUT/'MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')

+package com.wingedsheep.engine.scenarios
+
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.core.ActivateAbility
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.core.PaymentStrategy
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.player.ManaPoolComponent
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.support.GameTestDriver

+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.model.Deck
+import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
+import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
+
+/** Diagnostic only: this fixture is never added to the production card catalog. */
+class ActivatedPhyrexianPaymentDiagnosticTest : FunSpec({
+    val fixture = card("Manual Activated Phyrexian Payment Fixture") {
+        manaCost = "{2}"
+        typeLine = "Artifact Creature — Construct"
+        power = 0
+        toughness = 4
+        activatedAbility {
+            cost = Costs.Mana("{U/P}")
+            effect = Effects.GainLife(1)
+        }
+    }
+    fun driver() = GameTestDriver().also {
+        it.registerCards(TestCards.all + listOf(fixture))
+        it.initMirrorMatch(Deck.of("Island" to 40))
+        it.passPriorityUntil(Step.PRECOMBAT_MAIN)
+    }
+    fun blue(d: GameTestDriver) = d.state.getEntity(d.player1)?.get<ManaPoolComponent>()?.blue ?: 0
+
+    test("APD blue mana pays once and the fixture resolves") {
+        val d = driver()
+        val id = d.putCreatureOnBattlefield(d.player1, fixture.name)
+        d.giveMana(d.player1, Color.BLUE, 1)
+        val result = d.submit(ActivateAbility(d.player1, id, fixture.activatedAbilities.single().id,
+            paymentStrategy = PaymentStrategy.Explicit(emptyList())))
+        result.error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 20
+        blue(d) shouldBe 0
+        d.state.stack.size shouldBe 1
+        d.bothPass().error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 21
+        d.state.stack.size shouldBe 0
+    }
+
+    test("APD explicit life payment works without blue mana") {
+        val d = driver()
+        val id = d.putCreatureOnBattlefield(d.player1, fixture.name)
+        val result = d.submit(ActivateAbility(d.player1, id, fixture.activatedAbilities.single().id,
+            paymentStrategy = PaymentStrategy.Explicit(emptyList(), listOf(Color.BLUE))))
+        result.error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 18
+        blue(d) shouldBe 0
+        d.state.stack.size shouldBe 1
+        d.bothPass().error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 19
+    }
+
+    test("APD chosen life payment preserves available blue mana") {
+        val d = driver()
+        val id = d.putCreatureOnBattlefield(d.player1, fixture.name)
+        d.giveMana(d.player1, Color.BLUE, 1)
+        val result = d.submit(ActivateAbility(d.player1, id, fixture.activatedAbilities.single().id,
+            paymentStrategy = PaymentStrategy.Explicit(emptyList(), listOf(Color.BLUE))))
+        result.error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 18
+        blue(d) shouldBe 1
+        d.state.stack.size shouldBe 1
+        d.bothPass().error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 19
+    }
+
+    test("APD absent payment is rejected without changing state") {
+        val d = driver()
+        val id = d.putCreatureOnBattlefield(d.player1, fixture.name)
+        val before = d.state
+        val result = d.submit(ActivateAbility(d.player1, id, fixture.activatedAbilities.single().id,
+            paymentStrategy = PaymentStrategy.Explicit(emptyList())))
+        result.isSuccess shouldBe false
+        result.newState shouldBe before
+        result.events shouldBe emptyList()
+        d.state shouldBe before
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 20
+        blue(d) shouldBe 0
+    }
+})
